name: Taisetsu na Uta ~Koi Suru Yume Utahime~
original_name: たいせつなうた～恋する夢歌姫～
source:
Naoya has a broken heart when he moves to a new town. In his dreams he starts to meet unfamiliar girls in unfamiliar clothes, and he does not know which reality is true - they both look so real. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
